title: Christal NDE 5322
content: I was very sick. I had a kidney infection that had gotten so bad that all I could do was lie in bed, under 10 blankets, shaking badly. My husband was at work, not far away, and my daughter (age 13) was home. My daughter was in my room for some reason. I saw her, closed my eyes and then drifted out of consciousness. Everything was gray; foggy but it wasn't really 'fog.' Then, I found myself standing in a vertical tunnel. I say 'tunnel' for lack of a better word. It seemed more like a well and I was standing at the bottom of it. The top was about three feet above my head. It was dark in the 'well,' but there was a light (this sounds so lame!) at the top of it. As the light grew brighter, I could make out some people, sort of leaning over, peering in. I saw three of my grandparents. There were two other people who don't seem familiar to me now, but I remember knowing who they were at the time. I felt happy and very glad to see them. They spoke to me, but not with their mouths. I can't remember what they said. I reached my hand up as if to let them pull me out, but my grandmother scolded me, 'Not yet!' she said. I then started hearing a lot of voices, their voices and other voices. I remember gasping for air, and as I did, it sucked me back into the bed. I opened my eyes to my husband shaking me and my daughter sobbing, 'you weren't breathing!' She had freaked out and called my husband and he had rushed home. Then, they took me to the doctor. I didn't tell them what had happened, but I told my mom later and she was glad to hear about her parents. Ever since this happened, I feel a sort of sadness, and I really want to go back there. I know I will, someday, and it gives me great peace to know (because now I really do know) that I will see my loved ones again, and that there is life after death.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described it as a vertical tunnel, more like a well, standing at the bottom with the top about three feet above her head.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two other people were present who were not familiar to her later, but she remembered knowing who they were at the time.

environment.environment_other_detail: Everything was gray and foggy (but 'not really fog'); dark 'well' with light at the top.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe kidney infection; daughter reported she 'wasn't breathing.'

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Gray/foggy darkness transitioned into standing in a vertical 'well' with light above and deceased grandparents leaning over; boundary occurred via grandmother saying 'Not yet!' followed by abrupt return with a gasp back into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Vertical tunnel/well with the top only about three feet above her head; she was standing at the bottom while others leaned over and peered in.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Not yet!” / “you weren't breathing!” / “Everything was gray; foggy but it wasn't really 'fog.'”
